A ₹ B means ‘A is the father of B’,

A + B का अर्थ है कि ‘A, B का भाई है’ और
A @ B का अर्थ है कि ‘A, B का पुत्र है’।

The recent global chip shortage during the pandemic is repeatedly being cited as a warning sign. Supply disruptions affected everything from car production to electronics manufacturing, exposing how vulnerable countries become when they lack domestic semiconductor capacity. Those backing domestic semiconductor manufacturing say the issue goes beyond technology alone. Setting up fabrication plants creates an entire industrial ecosystem.
